scope: First scheduled production producer executions after the October 28 worker release. Application completion and native Blob receipts checked separately from Azure process status.

zopedia-learning.error_summary: 16 learning critiques and 4 reviews remain pending; 0 cases deferred; completed work is retained.

open_findings.impact: Four company investigations (BSX, LITE, MXL, VRT) failed at the shared durable checkpoint after completed business-profile output.
open_findings.evidence: PostgreSQL UntranslatableCharacter: \u0000 cannot be converted to text. Context contains PDF binary bytes. HTTP browsing currently decodes every successful non-HTML response using response.text.
open_findings.required_followup: Correct binary document extraction and preserve raw bytes separately; verify shared durable checkpoints accept supported text without discarding evidence.

open_findings.impact: 148 embedding requests rejected by budget admission; semantic candidate search degraded to its keyword path.
open_findings.evidence: services.llm.LLMProviderUnavailable: Budget admission requires a published price for the configured model. Trace runs from semantic_candidates through generate_embeddings to _request_maximum_charge.
open_findings.required_followup: Reconcile the actual Azure embedding deployment with its price and input-only request contract in the shared budget gateway; verify semantic retrieval with the production configuration.

open_findings.impact: EDGAR filings Blob dataset published, but the durable logical-run publication checkpoint reported RuntimeError. Other subsequent datasets and final job receipt persisted.
open_findings.evidence: Native completion receipt includes both the published edgar_filings immutable version and publication_checkpoint:edgar_filings=RuntimeError. This catch records only the exception class.
open_findings.required_followup: Establish the cause of the state-store failure and verify retry restoration; retain actionable error diagnostics without exposing secrets.

open_findings.impact: Nine of 25 critiques completed; 16 critiques and four generated reviews remained pending. No platform deadline termination.
open_findings.evidence: Persisted critic execution metadata for all 16 pending cases says the remaining learning window cannot fund another complete case. Current job summary says zero deferred because the per-case admission path does not increment cases_deferred. Old FileNotFoundError metadata also remains on some prior events; it is not proof that the new durable replay failed.
open_findings.required_followup: Correct the deferred-work summary and verify subsequent durable backlog progress before claiming the entire learning workload complete.

historical_acceptance: The existing local/DEV acceptance and deployment receipts remain valid evidence of those checks, not proof of complete scheduled production success.
